rawContent: I don't remember people asking THE MEN who came forward to report sexual crimes committed within the confines of the Catholic Church while they were young why they waited 30 years to report it. #MeToo

I'm reading the #WhyIDidntReport posts. My situation is different; l did report. And because I was assaulted by someone "important", at the age of 19 my life was completely unhinged by private investigators who needed to make me look responsible. #MeToo #ThisIsWhyTheyDontReport

I got it! The reason why so many men are upset about the #MeToo & #WhyIDidntReport movements is that women have stolen their moves! "Blame them then shame them!" They don't like it when it goes the other way, do they?
